rules.v: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
rules.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
rules.n: Licensing by the Bureau with a bank guarantee; licences can be cancelled; no joint liability with the employer.

rules.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
rules.v: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
rules.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
rules.n: Agency fees are regulated by the Bureau; employers bear recruitment costs for domestic workers under the standard contract; other workers pay capped fees.

rules.v: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
rules.n: Registration requires an approved contract; standard contracts are set for domestic workers in the main destinations.

rules.v: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
rules.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
rules.n: Training with a certificate is compulsory for domestic workers; orientation for other categories; fees may apply.

rules.v: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
rules.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.n: Registration includes compulsory insurance and contributions to the Workers' Welfare Fund, which pays for death, disability and repatriation and supports families.

rules.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.v: Officers are posted by administrative decision or policy, without a statutory duty
rules.vi: Atase ditempatkan berdasarkan keputusan administratif atau kebijakan, tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
rules.n: Labor welfare sections are placed in missions by the Bureau and the ministry; a statutory duty was not found.

rules.v: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
rules.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
rules.n: The Bureau conciliates, inquires into complaints and can order refunds and cancel licences; compensation beyond fees needs the courts.

rules.f: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
rules.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
rules.v: Restrictions whose terms apply to women only (higher minimum ages, consent requirements, bans)
rules.vi: Pembatasan yang secara tertulis hanya berlaku bagi perempuan (usia minimum lebih tinggi, syarat izin, larangan)
rules.n: Minimum ages for women in domestic work (21 under the 2022 revision, higher for some destinations in earlier rules); the Family Background Report for mothers of young children was removed in 2022.
rules.s: Newsfirst 21 Jun 2022; Daily FT, Cabinet decision 2022

rules.v: Reintegration rests on policy or programs without a statutory duty
rules.vi: Reintegrasi bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
rules.n: The Sub-Policy and National Action Plan on Return and Reintegration (2015) rests on policy, not statute.

rules.f: Shelter for workers in distress abroad
rules.fi: Tempat penampungan bagi pekerja bermasalah di luar negeri
rules.v: Shelters or safe houses are run at some missions by policy or practice
rules.vi: Tempat penampungan dikelola di sebagian perwakilan berdasarkan kebijakan atau praktik
rules.n: Safe houses for workers in distress are run at several missions by the Bureau.

rules.v: An official assistance line or crisis center for workers abroad operates 24 hours
rules.vi: Saluran bantuan atau crisis center resmi bagi pekerja di luar negeri beroperasi 24 jam
rules.n: The Bureau operates a 24-hour hotline.

rules.v: Legal assistance is funded by policy or discretionary funds
rules.vi: Bantuan hukum dibiayai berdasarkan kebijakan atau dana diskresioner
rules.n: The Workers' Welfare Fund supports workers in distress; no statutory legal aid for proceedings abroad was found.

rules.v: Gender-specific measures rest on policy or programs
rules.vi: Langkah khusus gender bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program
rules.n: The National Labour Migration Policy has measures for women workers; no specific statutory provision on violence.

rules.fi: Kematian di luar negeri: pemulangan dan pemeriksaan
rules.v: Repatriation and a death benefit are provided, without a route to establish the cause of death
rules.vi: Pemulangan dan santunan kematian diberikan, tanpa jalur untuk memastikan sebab kematian
rules.n: Insurance and the Welfare Fund cover death benefits and repatriation; no independent examination route found.

rules.fi: UU antiperdagangan orang yang mencakup kerja
rules.v: Trafficking is an offense under the general criminal law, with limited victim provisions
rules.vi: Perdagangan orang adalah tindak pidana dalam hukum pidana umum, dengan ketentuan korban yang terbatas
rules.n: Trafficking is an offense under the Penal Code (s. 360C, 2006); victims are covered by the 2015 victims and witnesses protection act.
rules.s: Penal Code s. 360C; Act No. 4 of 2015

decisions.nm: Challenge to the rule on women’s migration for domestic work (husband’s consent)
decisions.pe: Sri Lanka required women who wanted to work abroad as domestic workers to get their family’s approval. A woman said this was unequal treatment. The Supreme Court did not let the case go ahead. The government later dropped the requirement itself.
decisions.pi: Sri Lanka mewajibkan perempuan yang ingin bekerja di luar negeri sebagai pekerja rumah tangga mendapat persetujuan keluarga. Seorang perempuan menyebutnya perlakuan tidak setara. Mahkamah Agung tidak melanjutkan perkara itu. Pemerintah kemudian menghapus syarat itu sendiri.

help.nm: Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment (SLBFE) hotline 1989
help.de: Government hotline for Sri Lankan migrant workers. Take complaints about employers abroad and recruitment fraud, and check whether an agency is licensed before you pay.
help.di: Saluran pemerintah bagi pekerja migran Sri Lanka. Menerima pengaduan tentang majikan di luar negeri dan penipuan perekrutan, serta memeriksa apakah agen berizin sebelum Anda membayar.
